title: MITRE ATT&CK
description: Documented public threat knowledge base (MITRE) for the Cybersecurity Simulator capability area.
body:
MITRE ATT&CK is a documented threat knowledge base from MITRE. The Adversarial Tactics, Techniques & Common Knowledge matrix: the shared language of attacker behavior used by defenders worldwide.

How it works: It works by scoring each indicator on severity, confidence, and recency, ranking them and assigning block/monitor/log actions.

Documented uses of this capability area include supercomputer job scheduling, cryptographic migration planning, chaos-engineering programs, and disaster-recovery verification.
